title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The last cache without a ceiling
summary: The usage count cache kept every scan the editor ever showed. The reference project would produce 23 628 of them, each holding a list of usage sites.

highlights.title: Usage counts stop piling up
highlights.description: Every lens you scroll past resolves a usage scan whose result was kept for good. It now keeps 512, sized on the measurement that a single dense file produces 202 lenses on its own.

highlights.title: Work in flight is never dropped
highlights.description: The ceiling skips entries whose result has not arrived, or that a request is still waiting on, so capping cannot cancel a scan or make the same symbol scan twice.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: This was the last per session cache without a ceiling. The four keyed by file were capped in the previous three releases.
Checked on the repository benchmark: no measurable change.
